Chemosensory_Tarsal_Organs.description: True arachnids completely lack functioning noses. Instead, their literal sense of smell is located in incredibly specialized, microscopic pores running down the length of all eight legs, allowing them to perfectly track a moth's pheromone trail simply by walking over it.

Pedipalp_Olfactory_Sensilla.description: The front 'boxing glove' appendages (pedipalps) are overwhelmingly densely packed with volatile chemical receptors. The entity constantly waves them wildly in the air, dynamically painting a perfect, high-resolution 3D map of the surrounding olfactory environment.

Pheromone_Plume_Detectors.description: Microscopic pores deeply embedded in the carapace specifically heavily tuned to incredibly faint plumes of female mating pheromones blowing from miles away, completely overriding the entity's desire for self-preservation.

Hygroreceptive_Humidity_Sensors.description: While not smelling standard odors, these highly specialized tarsal organs can flawlessly detect single-digit changes in ambient atmospheric humidity. In a sprawling, lethal desert, this perfectly guides the entity directly to life-saving hidden oasis micro-climates.

Necrotic_Tissue_Chemoreceptors.description: Sensilla radically tuned to aggressively isolate the specific volatile gases emitted by putrefying meat (putrescine and cadaverine). It allows scavengers to detect a dead elephant buried completely under three feet of solid jungle mud.

Web_Bound_Taste_Pores.description: The entity frequently physically eats and re-consumes its own web. The spider perfectly 'tastes' the entire history of the web—the chemical residue of insects that escaped, heavy metal pollutants in the air, and changes in the local spore count.

CO2_Detection_Hairs.description: Haller's organs on the front legs tuned entirely to the massively elevated carbon dioxide plumes violently exhaled by heavily panting, massive mammalian prey pushing through the tall grass.

Thermoreceptive_Infrared_Pits.description: Strange, completely unpigmented pits essentially functioning exactly like the heat-sensing organs of a pit viper. In absolute utter darkness, a warm-blooded mouse glows like a screaming bonfire to this completely blind entity.

Contact_Chemoreception_Pads.description: The entity must physically intimately touch an object to 'smell' it. It rapidly drums its pedipalps over the frantically struggling prey's carapace to instantly locate the exact, perfectly unsclerotized weak point to sink its fangs into.

Water_Quality_Sensilla.description: Underwater hairs specifically tasked with analyzing dissolved oxygen content and extreme changes in water salinity or pH, preventing the diving bell spider from accidentally constructing its underwater web in horribly toxic, stagnant water gradients.
